text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
As I pass by the academy's outdoor
stage, I spot
Smart Falcon and Agnes
Tachyon engrossed in
conversation.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe! ☆ I'm so happy! Ask me anything
you
wanna know! ♪

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Heh-heh... But of course, Falco.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Oh, Trainer! Hey, listen to this!
choice_data_list_en: Both of you look like you're having fun.
You both look like you're having fun.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
I was just doing a bit of
self-promotion—you
know, letting
everyone know I'm working hard to

become a top Umadol! ☆

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
And then Tachyon here told me that she
wanted
to hear all the deets. ♪

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Yes... that's an indisputable fact.
However, there
is no need to get into
the nuts and bolts.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
I merely wish to analyze her potential for
speed.
The latent power that lies
dormant in the flesh of
every
Umamusume!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Is there a measurable difference in the
effects of
the endorphins she secretes?
Are the conduction
velocities of her
nerve impulses in some way
unique?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
I want to begin my research on Falco!

Immediately!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Whaaat?! But if you want to study me
right here
and now... th-that can only
mean...

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: You must be a huge fan! ♪

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Well, yeah—'cause I'm the same way! I
study
everything about my fave idols as
part of my
research to be a top
Umadol! ☆
choice_data_list: どうしてそうなるんだ……
choice_data_list_en: How does it end up like that...?
How did it end up like this...?

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
If you want to study me this much, it
must mean
that you're really taken by
me!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
That being the case, maybe I ought to
give you
an extra special treat.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Oho... An extra special treat, you say?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
May I take that as an offer... to
cooperate with
my research?

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Of course! I want to meet the
expectations of my
fans and increase my
Umadol power even more!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Which meeeans, I'll be with Tachyon for
a while,
Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Which meeeans, I'll be with Tachyon for
a while,
Trainer!

ウマドルパワー、上がるといいね
研究って、どんなことをするんだ？
研究って、どんなことをするの？
choice_data_list_en: Hope your Umadol power goes up.
Hope your Umadol power goes up!
What kind of research do you do?
What kind of research do you do?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Heh-heh... Then for our first step, why
don't we
head to the infirmary to give
you a thorough
health check?

ウマドルパワー、上がるといいね

研究って、どんなことをするの？
choice_data_list_en: Hope your Umadol power goes up.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
After that, I see them off to the infirmary
and go
back to my office.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Patter, patter, patter—crash!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Pant... Pant... Trainer...

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Here's the thing... When we got to the
infirmary...
choice_data_list: 息切らして、どうしたの！？
choice_data_list_en: You're all out of breath, what happened?!
You're all out of breath, what's wrong?!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Okay, Falco. Hurry up and take a seat,
please.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Sure! ☆ You mean in this big black chair,
right?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Clunk!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Wait—what is this?! Why can't I move?!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Heh-heh-heh... It's for my research. You
said
you'd give me an extra special treat,
did you not?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
In accordance with your words, I'm going
to use
your body... in a biological
experiment!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
E-experiment?! Nope! No way!
Absolutely not!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Rrrrip!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
...Oh! To think you could remove the
restraints by
force!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
AHAHAHA! Fascinating! So this is the
power of an
Umamusume—no, an
Umadol with her back
against the wall!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
...And after that, I got away as fast as I
could!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Urghhh... I guess it's no good trying to
raise my
Umadol power by just going
along with whatever
the fans want.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It's a difficult story to swallow in many
ways, but...
Umadol power aside, it
seems that she's grown
stronger in terms
of pure strength...

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Oh, I wanna know too! Tell us,
Tachyon! ☆

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Heh-heh. There's no need to be in such
a hurry.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: You'll be painfully aware of the details before long.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: H-huh?! "Painfully aware..."

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Hmm... Tachyon, what you just said...

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: It's just like what the killer said in episode nine of Shining ☆ Idol Detective !

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
It's this super interesting mystery series
starring
my fave idol!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
There's this scene where the main
character, the
idol detective, talks to
the bad guy.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
And just now, Tachyon sounded just like
the bad
guy in that scene. ...You
wouldn't happen to be
hiding
something, would you, Tachyon?!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
AHAHAHA! To think inspiration could
take this
form!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Well, it looks like I've been found out. In
that
case, I'm going to apply these
restraints right here
and now!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
R-restraints?! Nope! No way! Absolutely
not!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Whooooosh!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Heh-heh... AHAHAHA! As expected, my

assumption was correct!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
That reaction! That speed! Did quick
thinking
draw out your hidden physical
potential?!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
It seems like I can get more useful data
if I stick
to observation for the time
being!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It seems like Smart Falcon has overcome
a crisis
(?) with the quick wit born from
her daily idol
studies.
